# Command-line reference

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cli_docs.py from `braidworks --help`; do not edit by hand.
     Run `make cli-docs` after changing the command line. -->

Exact options for every `braidworks` command, rendered from its `--help`. For step-by-step tasks see the [how-to guides](../../how-to/); export fields are in [result exports](../results.md#command-line-exports).

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`get`](get.md) (alias `weave`) | look up --want for IDs (or --have TYPE=VALUE / --in-file), routing across sources. |
| [`runs`](runs.md) | list saved runs or inspect a run's status/review choices. |
| [`resume`](resume.md) | continue a saved run with its original query settings. |
| [`run`](run.md) | call ONE weaver capability directly (no routing). |
| [`weavers`](weavers.md) | list installed weavers and their capabilities. |
| [`keys`](keys.md) | list strand types and who produces / consumes them. |
| [`path`](path.md) | show the route between types without running it. |
| [`find`](find.md) | search the installed fields by meaning; use a match with --want or --have. |
| [`serve`](serve.md) | open the browser interface to build and run queries. |
| [`demo`](demo.md) | run example queries offline, on samples bundled with the sources. |
| [`doctor`](doctor.md) | check the installation and suggest fixes. |
| [`references`](references.md) | print source citations for installed weavers. |

```text
usage: braidworks [-h]
                  {get,weave,runs,resume,run,weavers,keys,path,find,serve,demo,doctor,references}
                  ...

Query and inspect the Braidworks weaver network from the shell.

positional arguments:
  {get,weave,runs,resume,run,weavers,keys,path,find,serve,demo,doctor,references}
    get (weave)         look up --want for IDs (or --have TYPE=VALUE / --in-file), routing across
                        sources.
    runs                list saved runs or inspect a run's status/review choices.
    resume              continue a saved run with its original query settings.
    run                 call ONE weaver capability directly (no routing).
    weavers             list installed weavers and their capabilities.
    keys                list strand types and who produces / consumes them.
    path                show the route between types without running it.
    find                search the installed fields by meaning; use a match with --want or --have.
    serve               open the browser interface to build and run queries.
    demo                run example queries offline, on samples bundled with the sources.
    doctor              check the installation and suggest fixes.
    references          print source citations for installed weavers.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

examples:
  braidworks doctor                     check the installation
  braidworks keys                       what you can start from and ask for
  braidworks get P04637 --have protein.query --want protein.name
```
